entities.name: Second Bible of Charles the Bald
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Second Bible of Charles the Bald is a 9th-century illuminated manuscript made in St. Amand's Abbey. It contains no miniatures though has many initials. The initials are made in a Franco-insular style.
